args.query: OpenAI Node SDK structured outputs with a zod schema

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK tool calling + Zod, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run an OpenAI chat tool-calling loop with Zod-validated tool arguments, tested offline by injecting a fake fetch into the official SDK.

results.title: OpenAI Python SDK structured outputs, tested with respx
results.summary: Call the OpenAI Python SDK and validate JSON output with Pydantic, testing success, malformed output and API errors offline by mocking HTTP with respx.

results.title: OpenAI chat.completions.parse with Pydantic output + respx mocks
results.summary: Get typed output from OpenAI chat.completions.parse using a Pydantic response_format, handle refusals and schema mismatches, and test offline with respx returning canned JSON.

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK streaming chat completions, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream chat completion deltas with the OpenAI SDK (for await over chunks), accumulate text and usage, and handle aborts, tested offline with a fake fetch that returns an SSE body.

results.title: Zod v4 schemas exported to JSON Schema and checked with Ajv
results.summary: Export Zod v4 schemas to JSON Schema 2020-12 with z.toJSONSchema, using .meta() ids and descriptions and input vs output modes, then validate the same data with Ajv 2020.

results.title: Vercel AI SDK tool loops, structured output and streaming with a mock model
results.summary: AI SDK generateText with a Zod-typed tool and a stopWhen step cap, Output.object structured results validated by Zod, and streamText deltas, all tested offline with MockLanguageModelV4 and simulateReadableStream from ai/test.

results.title: Anthropic TypeScript SDK tool use loop, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run a Claude tool_use loop with the official Anthropic SDK and Zod-validated tool inputs, tested offline with an injected fetch.

results.title: MCP server with in-memory tools
results.summary: Build an McpServer from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk that registers two zod-typed tools and one resource, then exercise it offline through a Client linked by InMemoryTransport.createLinkedPair().

results.title: NestJS Zod ValidationPipe for body DTOs
results.summary: Validate NestJS request bodies with a reusable Zod ValidationPipe that returns 400 field errors, tested through @nestjs/testing and supertest without relying on emitDecoratorMetadata.

results.title: Zod 4 schemas to an OpenAPI 3.1 document with zod-to-openapi
results.summary: Register Zod 4 schemas, path and query parameters, security schemes and routes in an OpenAPIRegistry and generate an OpenAPI 3.1 document (JSON and YAML) from the same schemas used for runtime validation, tested offline.
